## Langit Swarm {TAG} for Windows (64-bit)

Drone light show designer, simulator and fleet controller for 2,000–5,000 drones.

### Download and run
1. Download **LangitSwarm-{TAG}-windows-x64.zip** below.
2. Right-click the zip → **Extract All…** (do not run it from inside the zip).
3. Double-click **LangitSwarm.exe**. The black console window shows progress and the log; keep it open.
   - The app is not code-signed yet: if SmartScreen says *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info → Run anyway**.
   - The first start can take up to a minute while Windows checks the files.
4. Try it: *Design → Import Blender / Skybrush show…* → `samples\sample_100_drones.skyc`, then *Fleet & Show → Simulator*.

If the app window stays black, run `Safe mode (no GPU).cmd` or `Open in browser.cmd` from the same folder. Details: `START HERE.txt`.

### What changed
See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/yudhis7/LangitSwarm-/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

Requirements: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime for the app window (built into Windows 11), otherwise it opens in your browser. 8 GB RAM recommended for 3,000+ drones.

SHA-256 checksum: the `.sha256` file attached below.
